resources.string: A quieter view of your device.
Net power at the battery. This is not adapter wattage.
Estimated time suspended since this monitoring session began. Device suspend is different from Doze.
The graph stays in memory. Diagnostic recordings are saved only when you start one.
Only readable, identified sensors appear. Missing data stays unavailable.
Optional. Your root manager may ask for permission. Root unlocks more sensor readings and supported CPU governor controls. Each governor change needs a separate confirmation.
Battery power, temperature and session deep sleep. Updates every 15 seconds while awake; no wake lock.
Use an opaque surface for greater contrast.
Device data is read-only unless you explicitly change a supported CPU governor. Charging overrides, thermal bypass, frequency writes and boot scripts are not included.
Quiet updates for the monitoring session you started.
Notifications are off. Enable them in Android settings to use the live monitor.
Could not start the monitor. Try again while Butterd is open.
Root unavailable or denied. Standard monitoring still works.
Root read failed. Standard monitoring remains available; check access to retry.
Root access disabled. Applied governors are unchanged.
Some sensors could not be read. Available readings will continue.
Open your ROM’s controls. XiaomiParts handles changes and keeps its automation in sync.
XiaomiParts is not installed or does not expose compatible screens on this ROM.
That ROM screen is unavailable. No settings were changed.
Core status, cluster clocks and manual governor selection.
Frequency limits are managed by the ROM. Online cores are available to Android; this does not mean they are all busy.
Root enables supported governor choices. Changes can remain after closing Butterd until restored or rebooted. Nothing is applied at boot. ROM changes take priority.
No readable CPU policies. Check root access on the Device screen if you want to inspect more.
Change this cluster’s governor? This may affect responsiveness and battery use. Frequency and thermal limits remain with the ROM.
See what charging is doing, then record a diagnostic session.
A charging-disable flag does not prove hardware bypass. Power-path transitions and actual battery current still need verification.
Record battery power, temperatures, USB readings, charging commands and CPU state. Root adds readings only after you grant it.

Recordings stay on this phone until you choose to share. They contain device model, software versions and sensor readings, but no account information, serial number, IMEI or app list. Maximum 30 minutes or 2 MB. The latest two sessions are kept. A live notification is required; stopping it ends recording. Stopping recording leaves the live monitor on until you turn it off.

Start recording before changing anything. In XiaomiParts, reproduce your normal lower-power selection and bypass toggle. Add a marker after each change, then return here, stop recording and share the file. Butterd observes this test; it does not alter charging.
Readings from the driver, with the ROM in control.
GPU frequency controls remain ROM-managed in this version. Butterd does not lock clocks or override thermal and battery limits.
